badges.line: You live on both sides of this one. Genii couldn't call it, and honestly, neither could you.

halves.name: Trash-Talking Cuddle Bug
halves.desc: You want your people close, always. You show it by roasting them, saying it straight and writing your own rules for love.

axes.line: You recharge with your people. Close means shared.
You say the hard thing to their face, because that's respect.
You write your own script for love, home and holidays.

halves.name: Chill Personified
halves.desc: You don't race anyone's timeline. You go with the flow, but you never blow the budget doing it.

axes.line: Security first. Your leaps come with a safety net.
You run on your own clock. Other people's timelines are optional.
You read the room. Rules bend when a person needs them to.

stings: You call them annoying. Your real fear is the day they stop annoying you.
You're not unambitious. Nothing has been worth the grind yet.
hearts: I'm clingy and I tell the truth. You get the full set.
My life doesn't need a progress bar.

tags.name: Limited-edition energy
tags.heart: I charge myself first, so I have more to give.
tags.sting: Your kindness has a daily cap. When it's gone, it's gone.

youToldGenii.said: Admitted it was over my budget in the chat. Took three drafts.
'Got a thing tonight.' The thing: my couch. Offered the morning.
Pretend I'm asleep. Text them first thing at 7am.

tags.name: Bends rules for good reasons
tags.heart: I look at the person, not the form.
tags.sting: You think people made the rules, so the rules should bend for people.

youToldGenii.said: Worked around it quietly. Nobody got hurt.
The friend having the awful month. They need tonight.
Draw six. Stacking is the best part of Uno.

tags.name: The honest review nobody asked for
tags.heart: I'd rather annoy you than lie to you.
tags.sting: You think the truth is respect. Some people just feel poked.

youToldGenii.said: Told them straight it was wrong. Left on read for two days.
"The chorus needs work. Want notes before midnight?"
Critic: "Honestly? Not your best. Grow it out."

tags.name: Head over heels, eyes open
tags.heart: I love all the way, and I know where the door is.
tags.sting: You say you're independent. You still want to be in every part of their day.

youToldGenii.said: Stuck together all night. Basically one person with two phones.
Envy. Someone else got the good version of them.
We can do nothing together for hours and it's perfect.

tags.name: Team healer, IRL
tags.heart: I love the world, and I'm practicing loving me too.
tags.sting: You want to make the world better. On your own to-do list, you're always last.

youToldGenii.said: Got roped into a friend's bake sale. Honestly? Loved it.
The neighbor's. My plant has a backstory now.
Someone says 'I need hands' and I'm already putting on shoes.

calls.line: You've said 'can we do this tomorrow?' and meant it as an act of love.
You've let someone ahead of you in line because they looked stressed.
You've told someone about the spinach in their teeth, mid-conversation.

plotTwist.line: You'd say: ‘Let AI fix it. Add one typo so it sounds like me.’ Last time, you did: ‘Voice-noted my closest person. Four minutes, no summary.’

said.text: Let AI fix it. Add one typo so it sounds like me.

did.text: Voice-noted my closest person. Four minutes, no summary.
